chapter.verse: Tu-in Abram’ zi Sarai in ta nei lo hi. Amah in Hagar min nei Izipt mi numei- nasem khat nei hi;

Sarai in Abram’ kiangah, “Tu-in en in, Topa in ka ta neih ding hong khaktan hi; ka numei-nasem nu’ kiangah lum in; ama' sung panin keimah in ta a nei ding ka hi kha ding hi,” ci hi. Abram in Sarai’ thu mang hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, Kanaan leitangah Abram kum sawm a ten’ khit ciangin Abram’ zi Sarai in Izipt mi a numei-nasem Hagar la-in a pasal Abram’ tungah zi-in pia hi.
Amah in Hagar luppih a, Hagar gai hi; amah a gai lam a kitheih ciangin kiphasakin a tonu simmawh bawl hi.

Sarai in Abram’ kiangah, “Keimatungah a man lo-a hong kibawlna nangma' tungah hong tung ta hen! Nangma’ kawi dingin ka numei-nasem kong pia a, amah a gai khitna a kitheih ciangin kei hong simmawh bawlin, Topa in nang leh kei’ kikalah thu hong khen ta hen!” ci hi.
Ahih hangin Abram in Sarai’ kiangah, “En in, na numei-nasemnangma’ khut sungah om hi; na ut bangin ama' tungah bawl in,” ci hi. Tua ciangin Sarai in amah gawt bawl a, Hagar zong taikhia hi.
Topa ’ vantungmi in Shur paina lampi-a cik ahi, gamlak-a ciktui gei khatah amah mu hi.
Amah in, “Sarai’ numei-nasem Hagar aw, koi pan hong pai a, koi-ah pai ding na hi hiam?” ci hi. Amah in, “Ka tonu Sarai’ kiang panin a taikhia ka hi hi,” ci hi.
Topa ’ vantungmi in ama kiangah, “Na tonu' kiangah ciahkik in la, ama' tungah ki-ap in,” ci hi.
Topa ’ vantungmi in ama' kiangah, “Na suan-le-khakte nakpi takin tamsak ding ka hih manin amaute kisim zo lo ding hi,” zong ci lai hi.
Topa ’ vantungmi in ama' kiangah, “En in, nau na paai a, tapa khat na nei ding hi; ama' min Ishmael na phuak ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in nangma' thuakna hong mu khin hi.
Amah in mipa’ laa zual nai lo bang hi ding a, amah in mi khempeuh langpang-in mi khempeuh in ama' langpang ding hi; ama' behte khempeuh a langkhat lamah amah om ding hi,” ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin ama' tungah thu a gen Topa pen, “Nang in a mu thei Pasian khat na hi hi,” ci hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in, “Keimah in Pasian mu khin taktakin amah ka muh khit ciangin hing lai hilo ka hi hiam?” ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tua tuikhuk pen Be-erlahairoi kici hi; Kadesh leh Bered kikal-ah om hi.
Hagar in Abram tawh tapa khat nei hi; Abram in Hagar’ sung pan-a a suak ama’ tapa min Ishmael ci hi.
Hagar in Abram tawh a neih Ishmael a suah ciangin Abram kum sawmgiat-le-guk pha ta hi.
